dataset.cohort_sampling: frozen evaluation membership listed explicitly below

selection.scope: all model configurations copied unchanged from the completed 30-user discovery run
selection.primary_metric: mean user-macro Hit@R90 over all four observation ratios

parameter_rationale.source_unit: GeoLife distributes GPS recordings as separate PLT files. Each file is retained as the trajectory unit; no additional journey segmentation is introduced.
parameter_rationale.trip_filter: Ten valid points and five minutes ensure that the earliest 25% prefix contains at least two observations and that a destination task is not evaluated on very short recording fragments.
parameter_rationale.whole_trip_mode_filter: Transport labels describe intervals rather than files. Removing labelled rows would crop an original trajectory, so any explicitly non-ground overlap excludes the complete PLT file; unknown and all labelled ground modes are retained.
parameter_rationale.user_eligibility: Forty eligible trajectories guarantee at least ten temporally later outer-test trajectories before rounding, which supports user-level rate estimation.
parameter_rationale.cohort_size: The 37 users are the complete set among the 76 currently eligible users that does not occur in the 30-user discovery cohort, the earlier GeoLife users 001--013, or the earlier users 128, 153, and 163. No further sampling is performed.
parameter_rationale.cohort_sampling: The normalized cohort manifest records eligibility, discovery membership, prior use, and frozen evaluation membership. The explicit inclusion list is the complete set of 37 eligible users not used previously.
parameter_rationale.downsampling: Even downsampling to at most 200 points preserves both endpoints, limits sampling-density effects, and bounds the memory and alignment cost identically for all methods.
parameter_rationale.observation_ratios: The ratios represent early, midpoint, the historically used two-thirds condition, and late observation; all were fixed before validation and are aggregated for model selection.
parameter_rationale.chronological_split: The 75/25 outer split evaluates future recordings from each user, and the final 20% of the outer history provides a temporally later inner validation period without exposing outer-test endpoints.
parameter_rationale.dbscan_eps: Two hundred metres is used only as a local connectivity scale for training endpoints and matches the strict point-error reference; it is not imposed as the size of every destination region. Sensitivity at 100 and 300 m is reported.
parameter_rationale.dbscan_min_samples: A minimum of one retains every training destination, including destinations observed once. Raising this value would delete rare personal destinations and would confound destination prediction with an additional outlier-rejection rule.
parameter_rationale.support_quantiles: Training-only within-cluster quantiles describe empirically observed destination extent. Q80, Q90, and Q95 are all reported so conclusions cannot depend on Q90 alone; singleton radii remain zero and are complemented by fixed-200-m results.
parameter_rationale.fixed_geometric_configuration: Sixteen arc-length positions are copied from the discovery-validation winner; 32 and 64 were evaluated only in discovery and are not reconsidered in evaluation.
parameter_rationale.fixed_grid_pattern_configuration: The 800 m grid is an internal pattern-discretization scale rather than a destination-region radius. Together with the 2.5-cell emission width and posterior pool of 10, it is copied from the discovery-validation winner and is not retuned.
parameter_rationale.fixed_tsmini_configuration: The 64-dimensional embedding, 5 km trajectory-distance normalizer, and 15-epoch budget are copied from the discovery-validation winner. These values remain fixed during evaluation.
parameter_rationale.fixed_recurrent_configuration: The unidirectional 64-unit GRU and 30-epoch budget are copied from the discovery-validation winner. The public method identifier reflects the selected recurrent classifier rather than the broader bidirectional candidate family considered during discovery.
parameter_rationale.neural_seeds: Five consecutive prespecified seeds expose stochastic training variability separately from case-sampling uncertainty.
parameter_rationale.grid_pattern_alignment_states: Probabilistic grid-pattern prefixes are represented by 32 equally spaced alignment states, the midpoint of the discovery experiment's prespecified 16/32/64 geometric resolution grid. The 800 m cell scale, 2.5-cell emission width, and posterior pool of 10 are copied unchanged from discovery validation.
parameter_rationale.grid_candidate_ties: The frozen cross-method execution first reproduces the historical NumPy ordering inherited from discovery. Publication-facing grid estimates are then recomputed with lexicographic source-trajectory identifiers by the registered post-hoc tie_sensitivity run; no model parameter is selected or changed.
parameter_rationale.tsmini_fixed_architecture: Convolutional and transformer constants are copied from the public TSMini reference configuration. The 64-dimensional embedding, 5 km distance normalization, and 15-epoch budget are copied unchanged from discovery validation; the official weighted-MSE plus kNN-guided LambdaLoss objective is retained.
parameter_rationale.tsmini_target_resampling: Thirty-two arc-length positions are used to form the conventional prefix-distance supervision because this is the central member of the prespecified 16/32/64 geometric resolution grid.
parameter_rationale.tsmini_cellspace_buffer: The 500 m buffer is the public TSMini reference preprocessing value and prevents boundary-normalization degeneracy; it is derived around training coordinates only.
parameter_rationale.neural_optimization: Learning rates, weight decay, batch sizes, dropout, user-embedding width, ranking k, and the 0.2/0.8 TSMini loss mixture follow the frozen discovery protocol. Structural dimensions and epoch budgets are copied without retuning from the discovery validation selections. Unit gradient clipping is a numerical safeguard and failed non-finite runs are rejected.
parameter_rationale.point_thresholds: Two hundred metres provides the strict point reference aligned with endpoint clustering, while one kilometre is retained only as the conventional coarse error threshold used in the preceding experiments; neither threshold defines the primary adaptive region.
parameter_rationale.dbscan_sensitivity: Connectivity radii of 100, 200, and 300 m provide a symmetric local sensitivity around the prespecified 200 m primary value without searching for a favorable test result.
parameter_rationale.quality_sensitivity: The primary analysis preserves official PLT units. A separate non-selective sensitivity excludes complete trajectories with a recording gap over one hour, non-increasing timestamps, or implied speed above 100 m/s; 100 m/s is above ordinary ground-transport operation, and one hour distinguishes a recording interruption from the within-trip sampling intervals typical of GeoLife.
parameter_rationale.bootstrap_replicates: Ten thousand paired replicates are used for stable percentile intervals; convergence is checked against the first five thousand replicates.
parameter_rationale.bootstrap_seed_and_confidence: Seed 20260723 is the date-coded protocol seed fixed for exact reproducibility and is unrelated to outcomes. The 95% interval is the conventional uncertainty level and was fixed before the frozen evaluation.
